source.name: UCI Tennis Major Tournament Match Statistics
source.authors: Shruti Jauhari, Aniket Morankar, Ernest Fokoue (2014)

split: 2013 Australian/French training, Wimbledon calibration, US Open test; tournament blocks, not timestamped pre-match validation
limitations: 2013 data cannot establish current player strength or live accuracy
Service-point totals reconstructed from serve points won and opponent total points won
Wimbledon total-points fields are blank; first-set column labels also contain duplicates in some files; calibration unavailable
Unknown precise match timestamps and event-specific final-set rules prevent production validation
No bookmaker prices, ROI or market-edge validation available
